Definition: Heman, the name of at least two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Heman is a person named 15 times in Scripture, in 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 2 Chronicles. The full story lives on the Heman profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Heman matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
